name: Sea-Dweller
description:
44mm – 2011 Model – Complete Set (Box & Papers)

A true first-generation Deepsea — the reference that redefined Rolex overengineering.
This 2011 piece carries the full presence of the original 44mm titan: unapologetically large, brutally capable, and built to survive pressure far beyond any diver’s limit.

Why This 2011 Model Stands Out:
• Early-run Deepseas are increasingly sought after by collectors
• Balanced proportions and classic DSSD dial layout
• Represents the era when Rolex overbuilt everything just to prove they could
• Perfect for buyers who want a serious tool watch with real heritage

Set & Condition:
• Complete Set: Box, papers, card — collector-approved
• 2011 production with authentic aging and character
• Excellent condition relative to age
• Bracelet and clasp present strong integrity and tension

Key Specs:
• 44mm Oystersteel case — unmistakable wrist presence
• Helium escape valve for saturation diving
• Ringlock System engineered for extreme depth
• Chromalight lume for long-lasting legibility

name: Air-King
description:
The Air-King 114200 is the definition of understated Rolex elegance — a clean 34mm Oyster case paired with a crisp white dial that wears beautifully on both medium and smaller wrists. This is the reference known for its reliability, simplicity, and pure Rolex DNA without unnecessary flash.

Why This Model Stands Out

• Classic white dial — among the most versatile and collectible configurations
• Perfect everyday Rolex: light, balanced, and incredibly comfortable
• Runs the proven Caliber 3130 movement
• Sapphire crystal + 100m water resistance
• Ideal as a first Rolex or a refinement piece in any collection

name: Sea-Dweller
description:
⚠️ SERIOUS COLLECTOR ALERT ⚠️

A clean and correct example of the iconic 40mm Rolex Sea-Dweller 16600 — the last of the classic tool-watch Sea-Dwellers before the Deepsea era. Increasingly hard to find locally in this condition.
This is the ideal piece for collectors who want a powerful vintage-leaning aesthetic without crossing into fragile “true vintage” territory. The 16600 is the final Rolex diver with old-school proportions and modern reliability — a true sweet spot in Sea-Dweller history.
